#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    FILE *fin = fopen("input.txt", "r");
    FILE *fout = fopen("output.txt", "w");
    if (!fin || !fout) {
        fin = stdin;
        fout = stdout;
    }

    int n;
    fscanf(fin, "%d", &n);
    int total = 2 * n;
    vector<vector<int>> dp(total, vector<int>(n + 1, 0));
    dp[0][1] = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i < total; i++) {
        vector<int>& prev = dp[i - 1];
        vector<int>& cur = dp[i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            int v = prev[j];
            if (j + 1 <= n) {
                cur[j + 1] = (cur[j + 1] + v) % MOD;
            }
            if (j - 1 >= 0) {
                cur[j - 1] = (cur[j - 1] + v) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = total - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
        int limit = total - 1 - i;
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j += 2) {
            if (j <= limit) {
                ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    fprintf(fout, "%d", ans);
    if (fout != stdout) fclose(fout);
    if (fin != stdin) fclose(fin);
    return 0;
}
